主要内容: Geospace Technologies Corporation announced a $29.4 million order from Seafloor Geophysical Solutions for over 2,300 deep water OBX seafloor nodes, expected to be delivered during its fiscal third quarter ending June 30, 2014. However, SGS recently informed the company that some of its previous capital commitment has been withdrawn, and it is now seeking new investors. This may result in a delay in the delivery of the system beyond the fiscal third quarter. The company currently cannot estimate when the delivery might occur. The filing includes forward-looking statements, which are based on assumptions and may differ materially from actual results due to risks outlined in the company's 10-K and 10-Q reports.
